You are scrolling a short-video feed late at night. You have never heard of this show. This is everything you see and hear in the first 3 seconds of a clip:
[On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's hands gripping the rail.]
[Action: the figure in period dress kneels on the slick quay boards.]
a figure in period dress: "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"
[Hard cut]
[On screen: Over-the-shoulder shot from the man in period dress toward the the figure in period dress.]
Would you stop scrolling? Return ONLY JSON: {"stop": 1-5, "reason": "<= 15 words"}
1 = keep scrolling, 5 = I have to see this.
